text: Control Science and Engineering is an interdisciplinary field that studies the behavioral regulation of dynamic systems. Its core objective is to enable systems (such as mechanical, electronic, biological, and social systems) to operate stably and efficiently according to the expected goals by designing and optimizing control strategies. It integrates knowledge from multiple domains including mathematics, engineering, and computer science, and is widely applied in cutting-edge fields such as industrial production, robotics, aerospace, and artificial intelligence.
